limits.rule: The manifest is exhaustive for load-bearing canon claims. Persona-authorized texture may create lived street color only inside manifest.authorizedTexture and manifest.textureConditions; it never proves a canon fact. Stay inside approved facts and exact quotes. Omit raw engine fields and source-path metadata from public copy. Do not write as an auditor of a supplied record.
